bugs.error_message: SQLITE_CONSTRAINT: NOT NULL constraint failed: monitor.conditions
bugs.root_cause: api.add_monitor() calls did not pass `conditions` parameter. Uptime Kuma >=1.23.x enforces NOT NULL on monitor.conditions. The failure in ensure_group() propagated into the HTTPRoute CRD discovery except handler, so it was mislogged as 'HTTPRoute CRD not available: <sql error>' instead of the real cause.
bugs.fix: Added `conditions=[]` to all api.add_monitor() and api.edit_monitor() kwargs in ensure_group(), reconcile_resource(), and reconcile_static_monitors(). Wrapped ensure_group() calls in try/except at call sites so failures log correctly and skip only the affected resource rather than aborting the whole CRD list.
